Subject: Pilot environment - request for short interim credits while PO workflow completes

Hi Kimberly,

Quick heads up — our procurement team hit a snag with internal legal over a change to our data flow appendix, which pushed our PO approval timeline out. The pilot environment is slated to wrap this Friday and we're seeing usage spike; without a top-up the sandbox will expire midweek and the clinical team won't be able to finish the last two integration tests.

Is there any possibility Redwood can provision a short interim credit or extend the trial by ~7 calendar days so we can finish the validation while procurement finishes the PO? We expect to have the PO signed and in your finance inbox by 2027-06-24.

If useful I can share the updated PO draft and the legal note that caused the hold. Appreciate any help — this pilot has been very promising.

Thanks,
Samantha Reid

Novamed Health

Ben / Markus — forwarding Novamed's note. They hit an internal legal review and procurement is delaying the PO. Customer says PO will land by 2027-06-24 but needs 7 days of runway to finish integration tests.

Details: account Novamed Health, deal RWI-2098. Current pilot consumption ~45k tokens/day; ask is for ~50-75k tokens to cover a week. They've attached the latest PO draft (PO_draft.pdf).

Proposed internal options:
- Approve a 50k token credit (no charge) for 10 days to be contingent on PO submission by 2027-06-25; or
- Offer a 75k token extension but require signed PO within 5 business days and Finance guarantees recovery if PO is rescinded.

I recommend option 1 to keep momentum — small cost, high probability of conversion. Can we get an approval and any finance constraints?

Thanks — K
